title: Amodei says he never sought open-weight ban, but favors restricting Chinese models - TCR 07/28/26
description:
Anthropic's Dario Amodei said Anthropic never advocated banning open-weight models and called safe open models a public good while drawing a China-specific line, China vowed "all necessary measures" against US AI sanctions and accused US labs of distilling its models, and Moonshot open-sourced Kimi K3's full 2.8-trillion-parameter weights, the largest open release yet.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-july-28-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:28 Amodei draws a China line on open weights
3:24 China's DUV tools deepen the chip rout
6:23 Safe Superintelligence scales Nvidia compute
8:54 AI guides the physical make-step
11:43 AI's open surfaces leak twice
14:55 Close

This episode covers Amodei's open-weight rebuttal and China-specific line, Beijing's countermeasure threat and distillation counter-charge, China's mass-produced DUV lithography tools crashing ASML and SK Hynix, CXMT's 466% Shanghai debut, Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence scaling Nvidia compute tenfold, and AI guiding the physical make-step across a new zeolite, a bone-repair peptide, and an evaporation-powered microrod array.

The day's spine is competition with China, and every major actor now has an on-the-record position pinned to it. Amodei rebutted the Nvidia-led open-weight bloc while backing a safety-testing body that would include Beijing, and China answered by threatening sanctions countermeasures and accusing US labs of copying its models - a charge that concedes how good those models have become. The same signal hit the markets: a report that China reached mass production on its own deep-ultraviolet lithography tools sent ASML sliding and knocked SK Hynix and Samsung down more than 10%, while CXMT rose 466% on debut and Moonshot released Kimi K3's full weights. Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence broke two years of silence to scale its compute an order of magnitude on the premise that alignment can lead deployment. Underneath the geopolitics, AI moved into fabrication itself - suggesting a synthesis route that produced a real thermally stable zeolite, designing a peptide that repaired bone across rats, rabbits, dogs, and macaques, and guiding a microrod array to 21.5%-efficient power from evaporation. Wiz's Atlas surfaced 200-plus zero-days in decades-audited open-source code as Microsoft shipped a defensive model watching 1.6 million networks.
